ways.label: Historic Walkway to Waikino
evidence: The walkway follows the railway line through the gorge and then opens out alongside the Ohinemuri River, passing through the huge Victoria Battery complex and terminating at the Waikino Station where a cafe and train rides can be investigated.
Return the same way or have your friends pick you up!
Starting at Karangahake Hall, walk through the foundations of the Crown Battery before climbing up onto the Western Portal Bridge over the river.

ways.label: Rail Tunnel Loop
evidence: Starting at Karangahake Hall, walk through the foundations of the Crown Battery before climbing up onto the Western Portal Bridge over the river.
From here there is a choice of completing the loop back to Karangahake, by walking downstream along the river, or you can choose to continue on the Historic Walkway by going upstream towards Waikino.

access_points.name: Karangahake Domain Car Park
access_points.quote: Karangahake Domain Car Park on SH2

doubts: Page describes the walkway in two sections; the Historic Walkway section itself starts at the Eastern Portal Bridge, but the full walkway is taken as starting at Karangahake Hall (where the page says to park and start the loop). The 4 hr return time and 4.3 km are the section's own figures. Victoria Battery 'short walk through the remains' is on the way to Waikino Station; the separate Victoria Battery Site heading is a walk from the cafe.
